text:
Riya: Quick ops thread  we need a slim plan for launch posts + benchmark narrative + webinar routing. Items: sitemap rows, JSON-LD (Article + Event), 8 legacy redirects, and HubSpot hidden UTMs. Can marketing/dev/SEO triage?
Ben: I can handle redirects. Drop the 8 slugs and Ill convert to Netlify _redirects and open a PR. Small example: `/old-launch-2021  /launch/2026  301!`
Charlotte: Ill own JSON-LD for the benchmark article and the Event for the webinar. Will include mainEntityOfPage, author, datePublished and virtual location.
Ian: Dev note  server-side render OG tags, add <link rel="canonical"> that strips utm_*, and ensure paginated benchmark uses rel=prev/next with only page=1 in sitemap.
SEO Bot: Reminder: noindex tag archive pages that duplicate content. Also validate Article schema fields (headline, author.name, image).
Riya: UTM standard: utm_source=(organic|paid), utm_medium=(cta|email|social), utm_campaign=launch_may2026. HubSpot: hidden fields campaign=launch_may2026, lead_source=organic; add leads to HS list Launch_May2026.
Ben:  will PR redirects after slug list; will also enforce 301s.
Charlotte:  drafting JSON-LD now; will post snippet in this thread for review.
Ian:  will add canonical handling and SSR OG in the same PR as the landing deploy.
Riya: Owners: Charlotte = JSON-LD + anchor map by tomorrow; Ben = redirects PR; Ian = SSR + canonical. I'll confirm HubSpot mapping with CS. Reply with :white_check_mark: to ack.
Ben: ✅
Charlotte: ✅
Ian: ✅
Riya: Thanks  will schedule a 10m prelaunch QA the morning of launch. :rocket:
